group_intro: Method: ChatGPT 4x4 sprite sheet (1254x1254, square cells) with three references pasted every prompt (dushy/work/idle frame, ali/out/idle frame, kiru-v2.png) plus an explicit Kiru colour line. Sliced with /tmp/gp/gsheet.py (gutters = min channel >= 249, alignment on the grass base), ~300x300 frames at 180 ms, converted with conv.py width mode (480 px wide, 16 frames). Sheets in design/gen/sheets-colour/group-<scene>.png; old GIFs kept as design/gen/group/<scene>-oldcolour.gif (Mac).

Colour: colour.py on a crop around Kiru (her column, top 62% of the frame) of the animated WebP, all 16 frames sampled; old and new measured the same way. This crop method reads the old files milder than the earlier frame-0 measurement listed below (e.g. hello 6.5 here vs 11.6 there), skin is lower on five of six scenes (welcome-ali about the same at 7.7, visually close to kiru-v2) and all six pass skin <= 9.0 / hair <= 9.5.

group/hello.note: 4x4 sheet; Kiru holds ONE tea glass in her left hand in all 16 frames and waves with the right; Dushy and Ali wave; one blink each

group/hug.note: home outfits (Ali floral green nighty, Dushy charcoal tee + olive shorts, Kiru floral pink nighty); step in to a group hug and back; Dushy head comes within ~4 px of the top in frames 6-8

group/welcome-dushy.note: Kiru trousers now BLACK; Dushy visible from frame 0 at the left with ONE dark suitcase, steps in and waves; suitcase touches the left edge in frames 0-2

group/welcome-ali.note: Ali now visible in frame 0 at the right with ONE peach suitcase, steps in and waves, steps back (loop no longer starts empty); suitcase touches the right edge in some frames

group/welcome-kiru.note: Kiru on the right with ONE black suitcase in the same hand in every frame; Dushy cheers, Ali claps; suitcase close to the right edge

group/birthday.note: party hats (Dushy blue, Ali pink, Kiru purple), hat tips 7-8 px below the top; Ali holds ONE cake with ONE candle in every frame; Dushy and Kiru clap
